ThingDef.label: autocannon head
ThingDef.description: A replaceable autocannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.

ThingDef.label: dual sniper cannon head

ThingDef.label: dual mortar head
ThingDef.description: An autonomous dual mortar upper assembly using physical shells. Mounted effects and upgrade details follow the active combat system.

ThingDef.label: flamethrower head
ThingDef.description: Flamethrower upper assembly. Craft it at the turret assembly bench and carry it to a base for 100 construction work. Fires across a forward 90-degree cone with a base range of 6 cells. Eligible pawns, buildings, flammable plants and loose items in the cone take direct flame damage without accuracy misses, but walls block the attack. Ignites flammable scenery and loose items; the resulting ordinary fire keeps burning and can spread after firing stops. Fire control protects non-hostile faction pawns from direct shots except aggressive mental states; residual fire is not protected. Aiming, burst timing and cooldown still apply. Upgradeable from tier 0 to 5.

ThingDef.label: minigun head
ThingDef.description: A replaceable minigun main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.

ThingDef.label: laser cannon head
ThingDef.description: A replaceable laser cannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V. Fires a high-penetration single shot that applies damage without projectile travel time. Accuracy and cover checks still apply.

ThingDef.label: missile launcher head
ThingDef.description: A replaceable missile launcher main head. Fires eight missiles in rapid succession along spreading, curved paths. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V.

ThingDef.label: Tesla coil head
ThingDef.description: A replaceable Tesla coil main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V. Base range is 5 cells. Each pulse hits living pawns and hostile buildings in range at once, through walls and without a miss roll. Pawns can take collateral damage regardless of faction; an installed fire-control module protects non-hostile faction pawns except aggressive mental states. It requires no aiming time or facing alignment; the post-shot cooldown still applies. Only left and right module slots are available.

ThingDef.label: quantum cannon head
ThingDef.description: A replaceable quantum cannon main head. Manufacture it at the turret assembly bench, then carry it to a base and complete 100 construction work to install it. The head supports tiers 0 through V. Applies instantaneous single-target damage through walls and roofs after normal aiming and burst intervals, without redirecting hits into cover. The small impact burst is visual only and causes no area damage. It fires at twice the minigun frequency. Friendly-fire protection requires a precision fire controller, as with other heads. It starts with higher weapon accuracy and gains further accuracy from head upgrades. A precision fire controller provides additional accuracy bonuses.

ThingDef.label: range radar module
ThingDef.description: Increases the range of the main and auxiliary weapons. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier. For multiple modules of this kind, use 100% of the strongest module's upgrade-effect value and 35% of each additional module's value when calculating the final stat. This also applies at tier 0.

ThingDef.label: shield module
ThingDef.description: Creates a recharging damage-absorption shield with a reset delay after it breaks. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier. For multiple modules of this kind, use 100% of the strongest module's upgrade-effect value and 35% of each additional module's value when calculating the final stat. This also applies at tier 0.

ThingDef.label: auxiliary autocannon module
ThingDef.description: A small autocannon with an independent firing cycle. Manufactured at tier 0; upgrade it through tier V while installed. Removing the module preserves its tier.

ThingDef.label: aiming assistant module
